sources_considered.why: Primary benchmark report documenting autonomous software reimplementation and its limitations.
First-person account of software built without traditional developers; examined as a possible counterexample.
Potentially relevant project account, but read_page returned HTTP 403. Search snippets were not treated as evidence.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction, paragraph describing the benchmark design
evidence_items.explanation: The report documents autonomous reimplementation of a substantial toolkit, making it relevant counterevidence to broad claims about indispensable human design. Its precise existing specifications and limited task scope do not establish a successful large project without human architectural input under this contract.

The author describes building a publishing company's operational software with AI. The account also describes human choices about architecture and controls; absence of traditional developers does not establish absence of competent human architectural input or independently verified project success.

unresolved_gaps: Neither the ten-year minimum nor the twenty-year stated duration has elapsed.
The reviewed examples do not establish all requirements for a decisive early counterexample.
Marcus supplied no threshold separating a big project from a smaller autonomous implementation.
